# Daily activity

Notes live at `YYYY-MM/YYYY-MM-DD.md`. Open a date through Obsidian's core Daily notes plugin or ask the agent to
create or update it using [the daily template](../templates/daily.md).

Daily notes index known meaningful activity, including non-agent work. Link to canonical records rather than
duplicate them; preserve earlier entries and never invent times or activity. See the kit's
[workflow](../../.scions/notebook-conventions/docs/workflow.md#daily-notes).
